title: Intelligence Brief - May 23, 2026
summary: Six concurrent accountability threads escalated in the May 20-23 window. ETHI committee report demands forced divestiture of PM controlled assets within 60 days of taking office (Carney screen covers 100+ entities tied to Brookfield; Liberals issued dissenting report). Special joint MAID committee is wrapping final hearings ahead of an Oct 2, 2026 deadline on the mental-illness expansion - majority of psychiatrist witnesses and every chair of psychiatry at a Canadian medical school oppose; Toronto plaintiff Brosseau filed a Charter challenge for emergency access. Ontario Superior Court stayed sexual-assault charges over CFNIS evidence-tampering, with the judge finding 'wilful police misconduct'. AG Hogan flagged $6.5B in First Nations funding disbursed with no outcomes tracking and 149,000 IRCC-flagged international students never investigated. Crown corporation flagged U.S.-routed artillery propellants destined for Israel despite the Ottawa 'freeze' - 164 active military export permits remain valid. Bill C-9 (Combatting Hate Act) passed the House 188-144 and is now in the Senate; CCLA warns it threatens the rights of every Canadian.

stories.title: ETHI committee: PM should be required to divest, not just blind-trust
stories.summary: House of Commons ethics committee tabled report recommending PMs sell all controlled assets within 60 days of assuming office. Liberal members issued dissenting report. Carney's conflict-of-interest screen covers 100+ corporate entities (Brookfield Asset Management + dozens of tied entities). Brookfield executive was questioned at committee about Carney's corporate connections. Screen administered by Carney's own chief of staff (Marc-Andre Blanchard) + Privy Council Clerk Michael Sabia.
stories.connection: Direct update to carney_conflicts_dossier.json. Reinforces severity-3 CRITICAL CoIA finding on charges sheet.

stories.title: MAID mental-illness expansion: Oct 2 committee deadline; Brosseau Charter challenge
stories.summary: Special joint committee of MPs+senators wrapping final hearings ahead of October 2 deadline for recommendations to government. Federal government has indicated it is prepared to table legislation to halt the expansion if committee recommends. Toronto plaintiff Claire Brosseau (49, bipolar) filed constitutional challenge against federal government seeking emergency MAID access; argues exclusion violates Charter. Psychiatry chairs at every Canadian medical school oppose expansion. Northern Ontario psychiatrists also opposing 2027 expansion.
stories.connection: Updates maid_investigation_report.json + maid_votes.json. Brosseau case is a Charter-vs-Rome-Statute pressure point.

stories.title: CFNIS evidence-tampering: ONSC stayed charges, judge cites 'wilful police misconduct'
stories.summary: Ontario Superior Court judge stayed assault and sexual-assault charges against an active CAF member; judge found military police 'tampered with evidence, showed bias and acted beyond scope of jurisdiction.' Judge: 'at best, unacceptable police negligence, and at worst, wilful police misconduct designed to elicit a different statement from the complainant than what she originally provided to the military police.' Retired military lawyer: 'abject example of a failure over the course of many years to hold investigators accountable for misconduct.' Retired colonel expert in military law has questioned 'the possibility of widespread misconduct within' CFNIS.
stories.connection: Independent confirmation that CFNIS misconduct is systemic, not a one-off.

stories.title: AG Hogan: $6.5B First Nations untracked; 149K IRCC students un-investigated
stories.summary: Auditor General of Canada said federal government 'fell short' in transforming long-term funding for First Nations communities. Indigenous Services Canada failed to 'effectively implement, monitor or assess' the New Fiscal Initiatives for First Nations program; continued eligibility of grant recipients not monitored. APTN: $6.5B disbursed with no tracking of life outcomes. Separate AG finding: Immigration Department failed to investigate more than 149,000 international students flagged as not complying with study-permit terms - anti-fraud controls deficient.
stories.connection: Updates intelligence_briefs/brief metrics. Reinforces narrative of fiduciary failure across ISC + IRCC. Pairs with procurement_anomalies.json and ag-findings.html.

stories.title: Arms to Israel: Crown corp flagged U.S.-routed propellants; NDP closing-bill failed
stories.summary: March 2025: a Crown corporation flagged U.S.-bound artillery propellants which were in part destined for Israel, more than a year after Canada declared it was no longer issuing permits for exports to Israel. 164 military export permits used to export goods to Israel in 2024; some valid for years. Ottawa had estimated ceiling of $136M in approved military export permits to Israel as of July 3, 2024. NDP private-member bill to end the exemption for weapons/ammunition destined for the U.S. FAILED in House of Commons in March 2026; 15 Liberal MPs broke ranks. Israeli customs data continues to suggest lethal Canadian arms are still being exported despite Ottawa's claims.
stories.connection: Direct update to data/arms_exports_israel.json and arms-exports.html. Material to Rome Statute Article 25(3)(c) aiding-and-abetting analysis. Strengthens dossier on Joly + Anandasangaree + 15 Liberal MPs who broke ranks.

stories.title: Bill C-9 (Combatting Hate Act) in Senate; CCLA warns it threatens every Canadian
stories.summary: Bill C-9 passed third reading in House of Commons 188-144 in late March 2026. CPC + NDP voted against. Religious exemption removed by amendment. Criminalizes obstruction of access to places of worship or other sites where identifiable groups gather - up to 10 years imprisonment. CCLA: 'threatens the rights of every Canadian' and 'risks criminalizing peaceful protest.' Canadian Labour Congress raised concerns. Bloc Quebecois supported. Now at Senate second reading. CIJA disclosed 73 contacts during JUST committee review (Investigation Leviathan Layer 1).
stories.connection: Updates ai-research.html + 5gw-subversion.html + the CIJA lobbying detail at data/cija_lobbying_detail.json. Pairs with subject_updates_apr2026.json.
